CASE FILE · NORDHAUSEN 1945

The Paperclip Secret

How America Hid the Crimes of Hitler's Scientists to Win the Race to the Moon

Coming soon · By JR Korvus

In 1969 the world cheered as a giant rocket carried men to the Moon. Few knew that some of the men behind it had run a Nazi rocket factory where thousands of prisoners died. This book shows how their pasts were hidden, and how the truth finally came out.

Tell me when it is out

What is inside

  • An introduction, 13 chapters and a conclusion
  • The rocket factory inside a mountain, and the prisoners who built the V-2
  • How Operation Paperclip brought German scientists to America and cleaned up their files
  • The doctors from Dachau, and the trial that asked the wrong questions
  • Huntsville, the Saturn V and the race to the Moon
  • The survivors, the reporter and the Nazi hunter who opened the vaults
  • A note on sources, with disputed facts clearly marked
